nodes.rationale: Snapshot of one PCA item plus the deterministic signals that produced its opportunity score; written by web/lib/radar-batch.ts. status CHECK predicted|procurement_found|expired.

nodes.label: future_opportunity_matches (table)
nodes.rationale: Latest per-company score only, not history: unlike `matches`, a rerun overwrites because the radar list only ever shows now.

nodes.label: future_opportunity_actions (table)
nodes.rationale: One saved/ignored choice per company x opportunity.

nodes.label: future_opportunity_analyses (table)
nodes.rationale: Cached 'Analisar com IA' result: one LLM call per company x opportunity ever; zero spend for items nobody opens.

nodes.label: No FK on item_number (opportunity survives plan-item replacement)
nodes.rationale: `lixto plans sync` replaces a plan's items with delete+insert; an opportunity must survive that because `detected_at` is the whole point ('found N days before publication'). FK on plan_id alone keeps the row anchored to a live plan.
nodes.norm_label: no fk on item_number (opportunity survives plan-item replacement)

nodes.label: detected_at is never rewritten by a rerun
nodes.rationale: Immutable evidence that Lixto saw the purchase before the tender existed; ground truth for lead-time analytics computed retroactively in V2.
nodes.norm_label: detected_at is never rewritten by a rerun

nodes.label: procurement_document_pages (table)
nodes.rationale: Per-page text (one row per PDF page) so the analysis worker can route doc-tier prompts over page-tagged text and citations can point at (sequence, page).

nodes.label: tender_analyses (table)
nodes.rationale: One deep, company-agnostic dossier per procurement; `version` increments when document_set_hash changes; `data` holds the full validated schema-2.0 payload.

nodes.label: tender_analysis_risks (table)
nodes.rationale: kind risk|red_flag|contradiction|amendment — contradictions between documents and amendments overriding older text are first-class rows.

nodes.label: analysis_jobs (table)
nodes.rationale: On-demand 'Analisar com IA' queue: web inserts queued rows, `lixto analyze jobs` claims them; partial index on queued/running keeps the claim cheap, (company_id, created_at) index backs the per-company daily cap.

nodes.label: Tender Analysis (cycle 25 feature)
nodes.rationale: Today's enrichment was a shallow index from at most two PDFs — enough to match and search, not to decide; users still read 150 pages. V1 replaces that pass with one deep, cited, company-agnostic dossier per procurement. Company fit stays a separate later step.

nodes.label: One pass replaces `enrich run`
nodes.rationale: New worker `lixto analyze run` writes procurement_enrichments + facet tables exactly as before (match engine, semantic search, recommend, digest untouched) AND the dossier tables; old worker, prompt and enrich-run schedule deleted; `enrich embed` stays.

nodes.label: Analysis payload schema_version 2.0
nodes.rationale: Facet keys of ENRICHMENT_SCHEMA plus executive_summary, object, overall_risk, facts, dates, requirements, penalties, risks, missing; additionalProperties false everywhere.

nodes.label: Fact vs inference vs missing guardrail
nodes.rationale: Structured LLM output schema-validated before persisting. Each statement is `fact` (must cite), `inference` (must say why), or the field goes to missing. Never invents values; never claims illegality, only 'may deserve legal review'. A fact with zero valid citations is downgraded to inference/low.
nodes.norm_label: fact vs inference vs missing guardrail

nodes.label: Citations (document sequence, page)
nodes.rationale: Every fact row carries (sequence, page) citations and confidence high|medium|low; the UI links each to the PNCP document URL + #page, no in-app PDF viewer.

nodes.label: document_set_hash (deterministic reprocessing)
nodes.rationale: md5 over active procurement_documents (sequence:published_at:url). Re-run only when the hash changes; `version` increments and the dossier is marked stale. One SQL shared verbatim by Python (analyze/worker.py) and TS (analysis-queries.ts) so both sides compute the same md5.

nodes.label: Two entry points, one worker
nodes.rationale: Cron analyses the fenced set under the global daily cap; the 'Analisar com IA' button enqueues an analysis_jobs row (web polls), capped per company by LIXTO_ANALYZE_USER_DAILY_CAP. Same analyze_one worker either way.

nodes.label: UI = detail page dossier
nodes.rationale: EnrichmentPanel becomes the dossier: header card, then resumo, itens, prazos, participação e habilitação, especificações restritivas, condições comerciais, garantias, penalidades, riscos e alertas, contradições, informações ausentes. Portuguese copy.

nodes.label: Newest documents override (amendments)
nodes.rationale: All active PDFs fed newest-last with publication dates so retificação/errata override; the dossier flags changed requirements as risks.kind='amendment'.

nodes.label: Analysis routing by input kind (text / pdf / structured)
nodes.rationale: Page text available → doc tier on page-tagged text of every PDF; extraction failed but ≤2 PDFs → doc tier with inline base64 files; nothing → cheap tier on PNCP metadata; on tier failure retry once with fallback provider.
nodes.norm_label: analysis routing by input kind (text / pdf / structured)

nodes.label: Enrichment facets (categories, requirements, cnaes, embeddings)
nodes.rationale: Facet tables link back to procurements and feed the match engine; since cycle 25 facet `requirements`/`risks` are derived from the dossier requirements/risks so the facet contract is unchanged.

nodes.label: Cost fence (LIXTO_FENCE_*)
nodes.rationale: Ingestion stays unfenced (HTTP only); details fetch and `lixto analyze run` only process procurements in fenced portals/modalities and open/upcoming. All limits are env, not code.

nodes.label: Global daily analysis cap (cron)
nodes.rationale: LIXTO_ENRICH_DAILY_CAP limits analyses written per day by `lixto analyze run`; name kept from cycle 18 for zero ops churn.

nodes.label: Per-company on-demand cap
nodes.rationale: On-demand jobs bypass the fence but are capped per company by LIXTO_ANALYZE_USER_DAILY_CAP (default 10).

nodes.label: Match engine (deterministic scoring, web/lib/match-engine.ts)
nodes.rationale: Company profile x procurement enrichment → 0-100 score + machine-readable reasons; no LLM at scoring time; raw weights sum >100 and are clamped.

nodes.label: extract_for_procurement (src/lixto/enrich/documents.py)
nodes.rationale: MAX_DOCS removed: every active PDF is extracted, per-page texts persisted; byte cap from LIXTO_ANALYZE_MAX_BYTES; cached rows without page rows are re-extracted.

nodes.label: analyze_one (src/lixto/analyze/worker.py)
nodes.rationale: hash → derive_me_epp → extract → items → build_prompt → route by input kind → validate → _persist enrichment + dossier in one transaction; ON CONFLICT bumps tender_analyses.version.

nodes.label: validate_analysis (src/lixto/analyze/schema.py)
nodes.rationale: Drops invalid citations (sequence must be a doc with pages, 1 <= page <= pages), downgrades uncited facts to inference/low, caps list sizes, derives facet requirements/risks from the dossier.

nodes.label: build_prompt (src/lixto/analyze/prompt.py)
nodes.rationale: Edital first, then documents by publication date ascending; each page tagged [DOC seq | title | página n]; stops at LIXTO_ANALYZE_MAX_CHARS and appends a TRUNCADO marker telling the model to record unread docs in missing.

nodes.label: lixto analyze jobs (CLI)
nodes.rationale: Exit code 0 even when all jobs errored — a bad edital must not fail the every-2-minutes schedule.

nodes.label: drain_jobs (src/lixto/analyze/jobs.py)
nodes.rationale: Claims one job per iteration with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED committed immediately so overlapping schedule runs never take the same job; re-queues `running` rows older than 30 min (crashed run).

nodes.label: enqueueAnalysis (web/lib/analysis-queries.ts)
nodes.rationale: Decision order: active job → return it; done and not stale → 'já foi analisada'; cap reached → error; procurement must be open/upcoming (checked in the INSERT ... SELECT WHERE EXISTS).

nodes.label: AnalyzeButton (web/components/analyze-button.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Client component: enqueues via server action, polls analysisStatusAction every 5 s while queued/running, router.refresh() on done; shows 'Reanalisar — documentos atualizados' when stale.

nodes.label: AnalysisPanel (web/components/analysis-panel.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Server component replacing EnrichmentPanel; renders the dossier full-width in the main column; ME/EPP badges still from procurement_enrichments.

nodes.label: Future Procurement Radar (cycle 24 feature)
nodes.rationale: Lixto was reactive (published notices only). Radar surfaces purchases likely to happen before the notice exists so a supplier can quote, stock and get compliant ahead of competitors. V1 tests one hypothesis using only PNCP Annual Procurement Plans matched to the company profile.

nodes.label: PCA — Planos de Contratação Anual
nodes.rationale: Only signal in V1; ingestion already existed (lixto plans sync) and stays nationwide/unfenced. ~65k rows/day; ~200k rows per 3-day window.

nodes.label: One opportunity = one PCA item
nodes.rationale: Traceable evidence, no clustering logic; grouping by agency+PDM is V2.

nodes.label: Two separate scores (opportunity vs company match)
nodes.rationale: Opportunity score answers 'will it happen?' from PCA data alone; company match score answers 'does it fit?' per profile. Both deterministic, no LLM per item.
nodes.norm_label: two separate scores (opportunity vs company match)

nodes.label: Opportunity score (0-100, will-it-happen)
nodes.rationale: pca_item base 50 + date_near (0-90 d) 30 / date_mid (90-180 d) 15 + recent_plan_update (60 d) 20; weights from LIXTO_RADAR_WEIGHT_*; clamped 0-100.

nodes.label: Company match score (0-100, does-it-fit)
nodes.rationale: Profile terms FTS on item title (+40), semantic_high >= 0.55 (+35) / semantic >= 0.40 (+20), state_ok/state_out, value_ok/value_out, exclusion (-60), no_profile; minimum 40 (RADAR_MATCH_MIN) to persist.

nodes.label: Deterministic 'why' (signals rendered, never LLM)
nodes.rationale: 'Por que estamos mostrando isso?' is always rendered from the structured signal/reason list (code + weight + detail).

nodes.label: Radar on-demand AI analysis (cached per opportunity x company)
nodes.rationale: LLM called only when a user clicks 'Analisar com IA'; result cached in future_opportunity_analyses; capped by LIXTO_RADAR_ANALYSIS_DAILY_CAP (20/company/day); model LIXTO_RADAR_ANALYSIS_MODEL → LIXTO_RECOMMEND_MODEL → gpt-5.1.
nodes.norm_label: radar on-demand ai analysis (cached per opportunity x company)

nodes.label: Radar horizon (desired_date within LIXTO_RADAR_HORIZON_DAYS)
nodes.rationale: Items with desired_date today..+365 d (or null) and plan year >= current; past-date or removed items become expired and leave the list.

nodes.label: Hedged copy (previsto / estimado / provável, never confirmado)
nodes.rationale: Copy must say likely / estimated / possible — a PCA item is never a confirmed purchase.
nodes.norm_label: hedged copy (previsto / estimado / provavel, never confirmado)

nodes.label: Validation deferred but not lost (detected_at + status)
nodes.rationale: Only detected_at and status ship in V1; a V2 linker sets procurement_found/expired so 'found N days before publication' is computable retroactively over V1 data.
nodes.norm_label: validation deferred but not lost (detected_at + status)

nodes.label: runRadarBatch (web/lib/radar-batch.ts)
nodes.rationale: Horizon select keyset-paged by (plan_id, item_number) in pages of 500; upsert never touches detected_at or procurement_found rows; expiry runs before the per-company matching pass so status='predicted' is final when candidates are read.

nodes.label: buildRadarCandidateQuery (web/lib/radar-match-queries.ts)
nodes.rationale: Candidates = FTS text_hit on title OR top-K (500) cosine similarity >= 0.40 from plan_item_embeddings; no profile embedding → NULL similarity, no CTE.

nodes.label: lixto plans embed (CLI)
nodes.rationale: --limit / LIXTO_RADAR_EMBED_LIMIT is a plain per-run cap, not the cross-run daily-cap machinery of the analysis cron. Optional: Radar works on term matches without it.

nodes.label: src/lixto/enrich/plan_embed.py
nodes.rationale: Mirrors enrich/embed.py exactly (batching, commit per batch, lazy LlmClient, stop-on-SDK-error, to_pgvector reused); env-free, horizon passed in by the CLI.

nodes.label: lixto radar run (CLI, thin HTTP trigger)
nodes.norm_label: lixto radar run (cli, thin http trigger)

nodes.label: /radar list page (web/app/(app)/radar/page.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Default view excludes ignored rows; ordered by match_score DESC, opportunity_score DESC, expected_date ASC; headline sums estimated_value of matched opportunities.

nodes.label: /radar/[id] detail page
nodes.rationale: Tenant rule: reachable only for opportunities the session company has a future_opportunity_matches row for, otherwise notFound().

nodes.label: RadarWhy (mandatory 'Por que estamos mostrando isso?' tables)
nodes.norm_label: radarwhy (mandatory 'por que estamos mostrando isso?' tables)

nodes.label: analyzeOpportunity (web/lib/radar-analysis.ts)
nodes.rationale: Cached row returned without an LLM call; else enforce daily cap, build prompt from only the facts the page shows, JSON response_format, insert ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING then re-read.

nodes.label: buildRadarAnalysisPrompt (pt-BR, hedged, JSON why/fit/preparation)
nodes.rationale: System prompt forbids inventing facts and says V1 has no history/competition data so the model does not fabricate those sections.

nodes.label: LIXTO_ENRICH_DAILY_CAP (cron analyses/day, 1500)
nodes.rationale: Name kept from cycle 18 even though it now caps `lixto analyze run` — zero ops churn.

nodes.label: LIXTO_LLM_MODEL_EMBED (gemini-embedding-001, 1536 dims, never falls back)
nodes.rationale: All vectors must come from one model; plan_item_embeddings must use the same model as procurement_embeddings/company_profiles.embedding, so changing it requires full re-embedding.

nodes.label: Schedule plans-sync (0 4 * * *, disabled until Radar go-live)
nodes.norm_label: schedule plans-sync (0 4 * * *, disabled until radar go-live)

nodes.label: Schedule plans-embed (20 4 * * *, disabled — spends embedding tokens)
nodes.norm_label: schedule plans-embed (20 4 * * *, disabled — spends embedding tokens)

nodes.label: Schedule radar-seed (Feb-31 manual chain: plans sync && plans embed && radar run)
nodes.norm_label: schedule radar-seed (feb-31 manual chain: plans sync && plans embed && radar run)

nodes.label: Radar go-live runbook
nodes.rationale: Decide the LLM provider first: plans-embed bills embedding tokens and LIXTO_LLM_MODEL_EMBED must equal the model enrich-embed already uses; seed once via radar-seed; enable plans-sync → plans-embed (optional) → radar-run; a company profile is required before matches appear.

nodes.label: Decision: analyze-run cron stays DISABLED (2026-09-08)
nodes.rationale: Analysis is on-demand only; only analyze-jobs, enrich-embed and recommend-run stay enabled. Do not enable analyze-run without the user.

nodes.label: Decision: all Radar schedules OFF until provider/model chosen
nodes.rationale: LLM provider/model undecided, no spend; PCA volume (~65k rows/day nationwide) must be accepted; prod needs a company profile before matches appear.
nodes.norm_label: decision: all radar schedules off until provider/model chosen

nodes.norm_label: product.md — future procurement radar mvp v1 (cycle 24)

nodes.label: Radar V2 — procurement linker + lead-time badge (roadmap)
nodes.rationale: Match future_opportunities against published procurements, transition status to procurement_found, compute lead time from detected_at.
